title: Inverted Water Sanctuary — Opening-World Diorama

source_references.role: primary composition and atmosphere reference; no pixel projection
water-boundary, sanctuary and transit-scale reference; no pixel projection
primary water-torus thickness and direct portal-arrival reference; the pictured staircase is explicitly excluded

identity_sentence: A miniature keepsake of the opening world: an ocean volcano lifts living water upward into a protected floating sanctuary whose impossible hydrology reads before any architecture.
signature_element: A wide reverse-water helix grows from the lower crater and blossoms into a horizontal moving water shield around the upper island.
world_role: Decorative art-prop Easter egg and modular environment prototype for the future opening area.
shape_language: a vertical three-act silhouette: grounded volcanic island, open helix, protected floating crown
a massive asymmetric ocean-current torus with readable volume, curling crest, foam filaments and suspended droplets
eroded basalt terraces with inhabited scale cues on every visible side
slender ivory-and-gold sanctuary spires gathered around a turquoise lagoon
a portal gate embedded directly in the water boundary, with no physical crossing outside it
radial resort pavilions, palms and landing beacons arranged without bridges or stairs

composition.primary_focal: the reverse-water ascent and its readable connection to both islands
composition.secondary_focal: the upper sanctuary and complete water boundary
composition.tertiary_focal: lower ruins, palms, waterfalls and the empty bus-arrival socket
composition.negative_space: preserve open sky around the middle helix and a clear gap outside the upper shield

motion: counter-phased water ribbons rotate upward without the islands spinning
the upper shield circulates in layered directions so it reads as a boundary rather than a rigid ring
waterfalls and foam drift with a slower phase than the main ascent
the floating island breathes subtly while the arrival beacon pulses
an awakening clip grows the shield and sanctuary light from a dormant state

parts index, assembly recipe, asset manifest and verification receipt

acceptance_cues: the lower crater, rising water and shield read as one causal system
the upper sanctuary remains legible inside—not replaced by—the shield

truth_boundary: This is a deterministic authored UC interpretation of the supplied concepts, not automatic image-to-3D reconstruction.
Unseen surfaces, exact scale, architecture and hydrology are authored interpretations.
The water uses loopable geometry and shading, not physically simulated fluid.
Structural and animation verification do not by themselves establish final visual acceptance.
No target-engine gameplay, navigation, networking or final bus integration claim is made.
